Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring proof of insurance to redeem a motor vehicle from impoundment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring proof of insurance to redeem a motorvehicle from impoundment; adding a new section to chapter 46.55 RCW;and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: If a motor vehicle is impounded as a result of a trafficinfraction, the registered owner of the vehicle must provide proof offinancial responsibility or motor vehicle insurance before the vehiclecan be redeemed. If the registered owner fails to provide proof offinancial responsibility or motor vehicle insurance within fourteencalendar days of the impound, the registered owner must pay the costsassociated with the tow and impound, a fine of three hundred fiftydollars to the department for deposit into the motor vehicle fund, andan additional fine of twenty dollars to the registered tow truckoperator for each day the vehicle is kept in impoundment after thefourteenday period.
